message.eyebrow: How many species? How many blood-group systems?
message.title: Different blood. One shared need: oxygen.
message.text: BHOC is being developed as one donor-independent oxygen-delivery platform with potential across species, compatibility across blood types, long room-temperature shelf life and reduced reliance on blood-bank logistics.
message.note: Development goal. Evidence remains product- and species-specific.
